title: Commonwealth of The Bahamas
capsule: The Commonwealth of The Bahamas is an archipelago state of some 700 islands and 2,400 cays in the Atlantic Ocean northwest of Cuba, the site of Columbus's first American landfall in 1492. It was a British colony from 1718, when Woodes Rogers was appointed the first Royal Governor and suppressed endemic piracy in Nassau Harbor, until independence on 10 July 1973 under Prime Minister Lynden Pindling of the Progressive Liberal Party. The country's economy diversified from sponging and sisal into offshore banking and tourism through the 20th century, and Nassau became one of the Western Hemisphere's leading financial centers. The Bahamas served as a key logistics and basing point for US Atlantic and Caribbean strategy during World War II under agreements signed in 1940.
